diagrams.title: Parallel Fleet Part 1 system flow
diagrams.content:
flowchart LR
  subgraph s1["Coordinator Layer"]
    n1["FleetCoordinator.run(units, base_commit)"]
    n2["overlap.decompose(units)"]
    n3["write_fleet_plan -> fleet.yaml"]
  end

  subgraph s2["Worktree Boundary"]
    n4["WorktreeManager.create()"]
    n5["foundation worktree"]
    n6["parallel lane worktrees"]
    n7["WorktreeManager.check_footprint_violation()"]
  end

  subgraph s3["Execution Phases"]
    n8["Foundation phase"]
    n9["FLEET phase"]
    n10["supervisor_start_fn(topic=\"<feature>__foundation\")"]
    n11["supervisor_start_fn x N lanes"]
  end

  subgraph s4["Merge FSM"]
    n12["trigger integrate.flow.yaml"]
    n13["MERGING"]
    n14["INTEGRATION_TESTING"]
    n15["ESCALATED"]
    n16["DONE"]
  end

  subgraph s5["Recovery and Teardown"]
    n17["WorktreeManager.remove()"]
    n18["WorktreeManager.reconcile()"]
    n19["FLEET_STATE.json"]
    n20["EVENTS.jsonl"]
    n21["feedback/HUMAN_QUESTIONS.md"]
  end

  n1 --> n2 --> n3 --> n4
  n4 --> n5
  n4 --> n6
  n5 --> n10 --> n8
  n8 -->|status=done| n9
  n8 -->|status=error| n15
  n9 --> n7
  n9 --> n11
  n11 --> n7
  n7 -->|violation| n15
  n7 -->|clean| n12
  n12 --> n13 --> n14
  n14 -->|tests pass| n16
  n14 -->|tests fail| n15
  n15 --> n21
  n15 --> n19
  n15 --> n20
  n16 --> n17 --> n18
  n17 --> n19
  n18 --> n19
  n18 --> n20
  n19 -->|resume| n1
  n20 -->|audit trail| n1
